en: Vintage monochrome (slightly hand‑tinted) postcard view of steep rocky cliffs with fortification walls and arches known as the Bock in Luxembourg City. At the top left stands a villa on the cliff edge; in the foreground a woman with an umbrella walks along a path beside a stone wall. On the right is a tall church spire rising above trees and rooftops. Printed red caption text across the top identifies the scene and publisher.
